capabilities.intent: One call registers the use-case services, so the host does not name each by hand.
capabilities.reuse: Call services.AddApplication() from the API composition root.

capabilities.intent: One call wires the database and repositories, so the host does not know EF Core details.
capabilities.reuse: Call services.AddInfrastructure(connectionString) from the API composition root, then InitializeDatabaseAsync on startup.

capabilities.intent: One place maps Result to HTTP, so no endpoint invents its own status handling.
capabilities.reuse: Derive request/response endpoints from ResultEndpoint and call SendResultAsync.

capabilities.intent: Expected failures travel as data, not exceptions.
capabilities.reuse: Return Result<T> from handlers; do not throw for validation or not-found. Endpoints map it to a transport status.

capabilities.intent: The only place that touches EF Core for users; the application never sees a DbContext.
capabilities.reuse: Registered for IUserRepository by AddInfrastructure; do not new it up directly.

capabilities.intent: The use-case layer owns the persistence contract it needs, not the database.
capabilities.reuse: Depend on IUserRepository from application services; implement it in Infrastructure only.

capabilities.intent: One cohesive place for the user use-case logic, independent of transport and database.
capabilities.reuse: Inject UserService into endpoints; it speaks IUserRepository, never EF Core directly.

capabilities.intent: One typed map of operations so HTTP and IPC cannot disagree about a shape.
capabilities.reuse: Add an operation here first; response types must resolve to generated DTOs.

capabilities.intent: Compiler-enforced parity: every operation has both an HTTP route and an IPC command.
capabilities.reuse: Add the operation to Operations, then its ROUTES and COMMANDS entry; omissions fail the build.

capabilities.intent: Domain-facing user data access that is oblivious to HTTP vs IPC.
capabilities.reuse: Inject UserRepository from ViewModels; copy this shape for new feature repositories.

capabilities.intent: The thick client's user use-cases, mirroring the API so both wires agree.
capabilities.reuse: Manage one UserStore in the Tauri app state; commands delegate to it.

capabilities.intent: One error type above the seam, so no ViewModel grows two error branches.
capabilities.reuse: Called only by NormalizingTransport. Do not catch raw wire errors elsewhere.

capabilities.intent: The thin-client wire; route knowledge lives in the registry, not in callers.
capabilities.reuse: Selected by provideTransport when not under Tauri. Do not call directly.

capabilities.intent: The thick-client wire; command knowledge lives in the registry, not in callers.
capabilities.reuse: Selected by provideTransport under Tauri. Do not call directly.

capabilities.intent: One error seam; every failure above it is already an AppError.
capabilities.reuse: Wrap the selected Transport at bootstrap. Never add error branching above this.

capabilities.intent: One abstract seam; View, ViewModel, and repositories never learn which wire is live.
capabilities.reuse: Inject Transport (the DI token) and call request(op, payload). Never branch on wire above this.

capabilities.intent: Collapse the whole "which world" decision to one factory at startup.
capabilities.reuse: Call provideTransport(apiBaseUrl) in the app config. Nothing else selects a wire.
